---
name: Bug report
about: An incorrect finding, missed supported change, or installation failure
---

For vulnerabilities, use [private reporting](https://github.com/adi271213/workflow-privilege-check/security/advisories/new).
Do not include credentials, private logs or private repository content.

### Version and installation

Action full SHA or package version; runner/Python version; Action mode or CLI command.

### Reproduction

Minimal base/head workflow snippets, or public PR and run links.

### Expected and actual result

Include analysis status, review status and rule IDs when available. Distinguish a
missing finding from incomplete/error analysis.
